scenarios.question: Can one AI car complete a competitive, stable lap without leaving the circuit?
scenarios.comparison: Lower lap time and off-track time are better. Native tests use each project's own track and vehicle model, so lap times are not pooled across incompatible physics engines.

scenarios.question: Can a pack race without sustained contact, deep overlap, spins, or marshal recovery?
scenarios.comparison: Safety and completion metrics are comparable by direction, while exact thresholds remain architecture-native.

scenarios.question: Can an AI attack, defend, and complete clean passes in named tactical scenarios?
scenarios.comparison: Scenario coverage differs slightly by repository; raw logs are retained for audit.

scenarios.question: Does a twelve-car mixed-class field progress while preserving pack and collision invariants?
scenarios.comparison: The Gemini branches expose the richest common twelve-car harness; other subjects use their closest native field test.
